title: Animal Husbandry
definition: Animal husbandry is a branch of agriculture concerned with the breeding, rearing, and management of livestock for meat, fibre, milk, eggs, and other products, serving as a critical pillar of rural livelihood and nutritional security in India.
importanceInUpsc: Highly relevant for UPSC Prelims (schemes, livestock census data, breed geography) and Mains GS-3 (Agriculture: economics of animal rearing, doubling farmers' income, food security, white and pink revolutions).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Animal Husbandry.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Indian Agriculture and Rural Economy
